name: hunk-review
description: Per-hunk review of Claude's changes in a terminal pane: accept, undo and comment on hunks, with comments that persist and can be re-sent.

autoOpen.title: Open the review pane when a turn leaves changes
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane after Claude finishes a turn that changed files (needs a wide terminal).

liveRefresh.title: Refresh the review after each file-changing tool call
liveRefresh.description: Keeps the pane live while Claude works. Turn off in very large repositories.
